annotations.title: Value a points balance or an award

description: What a balance of points or miles is worth at Points Frog's value for the program. Given the cash price of the same booking (and the award's taxes and fees), also works out the cents per point the award gets and whether that is a great, fair or poor use of the points, with the program page and award checker links.

cash_copay.description: The cash part of a points + cash award, in US dollars (default 0)

cash_price.description: Cash price of the same booking in US dollars

points.description: The balance, or the points or miles the award costs

program.description: Program slug, name or airline code, e.g. chase-ultimate-rewards, "Delta SkyMiles" or DL

taxes_and_fees.description: Cash still due on the award, in US dollars (default 0)

name: value_points
title: Value a points balance or an award
